caption: The drawing features a single, horizontally oriented, stylized figure of a whale occupying the center of the image. The whale has a simple, solid black-gray body with a distinct fluke (tail) on the right side, which is attached with a brown, angular patch that appears metallic or reinforced. Near the left end of the whale's back, there is a thin, vertical, black pole topped with a round sphere. The sphere is primarily dark blue with irregular brownish-yellow patches, suggesting a mottled or patterned appearance. Below the body of the whale, there is a thin, straight, brown rod extending downward, and a small black protrusion beneath the tail. The background is plain and uncolored, presenting a light beige tone, with no additional objects, scenery, or textures.
title: Whale Weather Vane
